svg.title: The riverside promenade nearest the viewer in early autumn: courses of mottled buff limestone slabs, widening toward the bottom of the screen, with a lit top edge and shaded joints, a cast-iron drain grate, and fallen maple leaves in red, rust and gold. A repeating strip over the ground fill (ADR-0042), world y 1280..1920; local y 0 is the level ground line. GENERIC BY CONSTRUCTION: no parapet, lamp, bridge or figure.
